pageByPage.covers: How to file; case identification; why this packet and not automatic closing; what is in the packet; where to file; filing fee; copies and service (through the first wrapped line).
pageByPage.findings: Case identification block carries county, judicial district and the order date as a court-readable long date. The date-split explanation states both branches, so a participant on the wrong side of the split can see it. No fee amount is stated anywhere; the source's no-fee rule is quoted. Readable at 78 characters; no line reaches the margin.

pageByPage.covers: Copies and service (continuation); after you file; what the order does and does not reach; safety statement; footer.
pageByPage.findings: The 10-day order rule and the explicit statement that the source prescribes no hearing and no objection window both appear. The court-system-only scope and the access limits appear before the participant files rather than only in the order. Paragraph continues across the page break mid-sentence, which is ordinary prose flow and not a filing defect.

pageByPage.covers: Caption; docket and judicial district block; document title; statutory authority; I. Jurisdiction and venue; II. Parties.
pageByPage.findings: Criminal caption with the State as Plaintiff and the filer as Petitioner, matching a petition filed in the existing criminal case. Title names N.D.C.C. 12-60.1-05. Both authority entries cite the operative section and carry state-pack text verbatim. No sovereign, court or agency from another state appears.

pageByPage.covers: III. Facts and case history; IV. Eligibility allegations; V. Requested relief.
pageByPage.findings: Allegations are numbered continuously across the page break (5 ends page 3, 6 opens page 4). The disposition is alleged as a nonconviction in the statute's own terms. Allegation 12 states the order date and the side of the split expressly. Allegation 13 negates all four statutory exclusions. Requested relief asks for a finding of nonconviction and a closing order under 12-60.1-05 only; it does not ask any agency outside the court system to act.

pageByPage.covers: VI. Verification; signature and date block; date-of-birth note; filed-with list; footer.
pageByPage.findings: Signature rule, signer name, address and date line are whole on one page; nothing is orphaned. No penalty recital appears, because no committed source ties a verification statute to this petition; the silence is recorded in the specification and carried as a counsel flag. The filed-with list names the proposed order as filed and the proof of service as filed only if the judge requires service.

pageByPage.covers: Order caption; docket; [PROPOSED] ORDER; AND NOW recital; three operative paragraphs; BY THE COURT signature block.
pageByPage.findings: The order closes the court record under 12-60.1-05, states the access limits verbatim, and states that it does not reach prosecutor or law-enforcement records. The judge's signature block is left blank for the court and is whole on the page. The petition's in-document heading and roman numeral are suppressed because this is a standalone document.

pageByPage.covers: Proof of service heading; the condition that makes it required; certification; recipient and address field; service method field; signature and date block; footer.
pageByPage.findings: The conditional nature is stated on the face of the document, so a participant whose judge does not require service does not file it by default. The prosecutor address and the service method remain confirm-before-filing fields rather than a guessed address. Signature block whole on the page.

findings.note: The packet asks only for closing of the court record and states, in the instructions and in the order, that the order does not reach prosecutor or law-enforcement records. The shared renderer's default agency-wide direction is not used on this route and is asserted absent by test.
N.D.C.C. 12-60.1-05 only. No subsection is attributed to the petition branch, because the committed sources identify a subsection only for the automatic branch; recorded as a source silence.
All four statutory exclusions are carried verbatim from the compiled ND profile, block both branches in the resolver, and are negated as an allegation in the petition.
No fee amount is stated. The source's rule that no filing fee may be charged is quoted, and no fee-waiver application is offered because none is needed.
None asserted. The packet states expressly that the source prescribes neither.
A plain declaration with no penalty recital, because no committed source ties a verification statute to this petition. Counsel flag carried.
No sentence in the output asserts a rule that is not traceable to the ND state pack or the compiled ND profile.

dateSplitReview.note: The boundary date itself is on the automatic side, matching the source's 'on or after August 1, 2025'. 2025-07-31 composes a packet; 2025-08-01 refuses one and explains the 61-day automatic closing. An absent, malformed or impossible order date resolves to unresolved rather than to a branch. Proven by scripts/verify-nd-composed-packet.mjs.

filingReadinessReview.note: Four documents, seven pages, complete application/pdf. Filing destination, fee, copies, post-filing timing, relief scope and access limits are all present and all sourced. Filing destination comes from governed matter facts; a matter without a judicial district or clerk destination is refused. Every line fits the 78-character Courier measure, no page exceeds 46 lines, no page opens or closes on a blank line, and no signature block is split or orphaned.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: The shared renderer's requested-relief clause (b) and proposed-order paragraph direct every criminal justice agency holding the record to act. On N.D.C.C. 12-60.1-05 the order reaches only records controlled by the North Dakota court system, so the default text asserted relief the statute does not grant.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: Added optional reliefClauses and proposedOrderClauses to the shared presentation and supplied this route's exact clauses. Omitted, every existing state renders byte for byte as before; asserted absent for this route by test.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: The proposed order and the proof of service kept the petition's in-document heading and roman numeral ('PROPOSED ORDER', 'VII. CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE') after being split out as standalone packet documents, misdescribing documents that are no longer sections of the petition.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: The composer overrides the heading per standalone document: the order carries only its own caption and [PROPOSED] ORDER title, and the service document is titled PROOF OF SERVICE ON THE PROSECUTING ATTORNEY.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: The renderer's attachment list named a 'Certificate of Service' that is not a document title in this packet and stated it unconditionally, although service on this route is conditional on the judge requiring it.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: The composer builds the filed-with list from the specification's own document titles and marks the conditional component as filed only if the judge requires service.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: Dates rendered in ISO form ('2021-04-12') inside the pleading body, which is not how a North Dakota filing reads.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: Added a locale-free, clock-free long-date formatter; ISO facts render as 'April 12, 2021' and a non-ISO value is left unchanged rather than guessed at.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: An allegation restated the court-system-only relief scope as a numbered allegation by the petitioner, where it belongs as participant guidance and as an operative paragraph of the order.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: Removed from the allegations; retained in the filing instructions and in the proposed order.

defectsFoundAndResolved.found: Page boundaries were invisible in the flattened text artifact, so a page-by-page visual review could not see where a page actually broke.
defectsFoundAndResolved.resolution: The generator also emits rendered/canonical-pages.txt, the same bytes with a page rule before each page. It is review scaffolding and is never part of the artifact.
